general.name: End of Service Award (accrual)
general.description: End-of-service award under the Saudi Labour Law: half a month's wage per year for the first five years of service, one month's wage per year thereafter. Shown here as a monthly employer provision.

eligibility.notes: Primarily accrued for expatriate employees (Saudi nationals draw a GOSI pension). Award is on the last full wage; the monthly figure here is an employer accrual, not an employee deduction.

calculationRules.name: Monthly award accrual
calculationRules.description: First five years: half a month's wage per year -> about 4.17% of wage per month. From year six: one month per year -> about 8.33%.
